meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 编辑类工具(apply_patch、write、edit 等)调用成功后,插件会运行 comment-checker;一旦出现警告,Claude 会收到阻断性反馈,需要先修正或解释被标记的注释再继续。
howto.when: 当 Codex 的编辑类操作(apply_patch、write、edit 等)成功后收到 comment-checker 警告时触发;非编辑工具不触发,缺少检查器程序时不产生任何输出。

say.text: 解释一下这次 edit 里被 comment-checker 标记的注释
say.note: Claude 会说明该警告的原因

say.text: 把 apply_patch 里被标记的注释改掉,再继续
帮我处理 comment-checker 的这条警告反馈
say.note: 修正或解释被标记的注释

howto.what_en: After a successful apply_patch, write, or edit call, the plugin runs comment-checker. If it reports a warning, Codex gets blocking feedback and must fix or explain the flagged comment before continuing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when an edit-like tool call (apply_patch, write, edit, etc.) succeeds and comment-checker emits a warning. Non-edit tools and a missing checker binary produce no hook output.

say_en.text: Explain the comment comment-checker flagged in this edit
say_en.note: Claude explains why it was flagged

say_en.text: Fix the flagged comment from the apply_patch, then continue
say_en.note: Handles the warning before moving on

say_en.text: Help me handle this comment-checker warning
say_en.note: Fix or explain the flagged comment
